# Pragmatic Design

> Pragmatic Design is a .NET 10 framework for line-of-business software. You describe the domain —
> entities, the operations on them, the rules they obey — with attributes and partial classes, and a
> single incremental source generator writes the rest: persistence, HTTP endpoints, validation,
> authorization, events, caching, DI wiring, OpenAPI. The generated code is plain C#, uses no runtime
> reflection (EF Core excepted), and mistakes are reported at build time as PRAG diagnostics.
> 45 modules, version 1.0.0-alpha.

Key facts for building an app:
- Two project shapes: a **boundary library** (entities, mutations, queries, actions) and a **web host**.
- A boundary library that declares `[Endpoint]` must reference `Pragmatic.Endpoints.AspNetCore`, and for entity infrastructure also `Pragmatic.Persistence.EFCore`.
- Entities live in the `{Boundary}.Entities` namespace (the generator derives the host database root namespace from it), each with `[Entity]` and `: IEntity`.
- Query projection DTOs are `partial class` + `[MapFrom<TEntity>]` + `[GenerateProjection]`.
- The host needs a `[Module]` topology class with `[Include<TModule, TDatabase>]`, an EF provider matching EF Core 10 (e.g. `Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL` 10.0.*), and a UI culture — `app.UseI18N(...)` with a default, or translation files in the modules.
- Repositories are `IRepository<TEntity>` / `IReadRepository<TEntity>`. Domain errors are values: `Result<T, IError>`, never exceptions.
- Outside Development, a host whose endpoints require authorization needs an authentication method (`UseJwtAuthentication`, `UseOidcAuthentication`, `UseKeycloakAuthentication`), or it refuses to start.
- To read the generated code: `<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>`, then `obj/Debug/net10.0/generated/`.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/getting-started/introduction/): what it is, why it exists, who it's for.
- [Installation](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/getting-started/installation/): packages, first action, inspecting generated code.
- [Build with an agent](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/getting-started/with-an-agent/): the Pragmatic skills for Claude Code, Codex and any agent that reads SKILL.md.
- [Architecture](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/getting-started/architecture/): 3-tier model, module layers, composition by presence.

## Source generator

- [How it works](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/source-generator/how-it-works/): the one unified incremental generator and the standalone ones.
- [Feature detection](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/source-generator/feature-detection/): how referenced packages activate generation.
- [Feature catalog](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/source-generator/feature-catalog/): every pipeline, its trigger, what it generates.

- [Configuration](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/reference/configuration/): the `Use*()` strategy API.

- [Glossary](https://docs.pragmaticdesign.net/reference/glossary/): boundary, module, host, invoker, trait, etc.
